datasets.name: action_schedule
queryLines:
WITH tasks AS (
        SELECT CASE action_type_id WHEN 'A-INSPECT' THEN 'Inspect M-1158' ELSE 'Move M-1184' END action,
               CASE action_type_id WHEN 'A-INSPECT' THEN 'Wed' ELSE 'Thu' END eligible_weekday,
               CAST(downtime_minutes / 60 AS INT) AS hours
        FROM workspace.royale.gold_action_plan WHERE selected AND horizon_days=30
        AND action_type_id IN ('A-INSPECT','A-MOVE-MACHINE')
      ), windows AS (
        SELECT t.action,t.hours,h.local_weekday,h.gaming_hour,
               SUM(p.theo_per_available_machine_hour) AS lost_theo_usd
        FROM tasks t CROSS JOIN workspace.royale.gold_forecast_tech_timing h
        JOIN workspace.royale.gold_forecast_tech_timing p ON p.local_weekday=h.local_weekday
          AND p.gaming_hour>=h.gaming_hour AND p.gaming_hour<h.gaming_hour+t.hours
        WHERE (h.local_weekday=t.eligible_weekday AND h.gaming_hour+t.hours<=24)
           OR (h.local_weekday='Sat' AND h.gaming_hour=13)
        GROUP BY ALL HAVING COUNT(*)=t.hours
      ), ranked AS (
        SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY action,local_weekday ORDER BY lost_theo_usd,gaming_hour) AS preference
        FROM windows
      )
      SELECT action,MAX(hours)*60 AS minutes,
             MAX(IF(local_weekday<>'Sat',local_weekday,NULL)) AS weekday,
             MAX(IF(local_weekday<>'Sat',gaming_hour,NULL)) AS start_hour,
             MAX(IF(local_weekday<>'Sat',lost_theo_usd,NULL)) AS quiet_usd,
             MAX(IF(local_weekday='Sat',lost_theo_usd,NULL)) AS saturday_usd
      FROM ranked WHERE preference=1 GROUP BY action

datasets.name: comparison
queryLines:
SELECT machine_id, theo_usd, house_win_usd, verdict_chip, gm_rank, adjusted_rank
            FROM workspace.royale.gold_machine_verdict WHERE gm_rank<=10 OR adjusted_rank<=10

datasets.name: traffic
queryLines:
SELECT *, CASE zone_id
            WHEN 'Z-B40' THEN 'Back Forty' WHEN 'Z-BAR' THEN 'Bar Row' WHEN 'Z-ENT' THEN 'Main Entrance'
            WHEN 'Z-GAR' THEN 'Garage Entrance' WHEN 'Z-HL' THEN 'High-Limit Room'
            WHEN 'Z-HTL' THEN 'Hotel Corridor' WHEN 'Z-PIT' THEN 'Center Pit' END AS zone_name
            FROM workspace.royale.gold_zone_gaming_hour

datasets.name: walkway
queryLines:

            ELSE 'After' END AS period FROM workspace.royale.gold_walkway_did

datasets.name: demand
queryLines:
SELECT d.*, f.forecast_usd, f.split FROM workspace.royale.gold_demand_context_day d
            JOIN workspace.royale.gold_forecast_day f USING (gaming_date)

datasets.name: ladder
queryLines:
SELECT player_rank,cumulative_player_share,cumulative_theo_share,cumulative_coin_in_share
            FROM workspace.royale.gold_lorenz WHERE PMOD(player_rank,400)=0 OR player_rank IN (1,1138,11389,113890)

datasets.name: segments
queryLines:
SELECT *, TO_DATE(CONCAT(period_month,'-01')) AS gaming_date
            FROM workspace.royale.gold_player_decile_month

datasets.name: hist
queryLines:
SELECT bin_id, CASE bin_id WHEN 0 THEN '0 No tracked gaming' WHEN 1 THEN '1 Below −$1,000'

            WHEN 5 THEN '5 Win up to $100' WHEN 6 THEN '6 $100 to $1,000' ELSE '7 Above $1,000' END AS band,
            observations, player_net_usd FROM workspace.royale.gold_player_net_histogram WHERE period='Jan–Jun'

datasets.name: hold_case

lines:
## We recommend not replacing any of the ten lowest-earning machines in July. Their low earnings come mostly from the Back Forty's lost foot traffic and from game settings, so we spend $10,500 on three tests: new signage for the Back Forty, a payout check on machine M-1158, and moving machine M-1184 to a busier spot to learn whether its weakness is the spot or the machine. We keep $89,500 in reserve.

**THE GILDED ACE · EYE IN THE SKY** · Fictional casino · Jan–Jun 2025 evidence

**Comp monitoring:** review comp pricing and tracked play if cost exceeds 1.50% of tracked theo for two consecutive complete gaming weeks.

[Ask the Pit Boss in Genie (workspace sign-in required)](https://dbc-a3bbfca6-850a.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1db4548ec16ee9f10853bb4959656?o=7474653288963289).

fields.expression: CASE metric WHEN 'relative_coin_in_pct' THEN 'Change in tracked wagers relative to untracked wagers' WHEN 'relative_coin_in_usd_week' THEN 'Change in tracked wagers per week relative to untracked wagers' WHEN 'carded_share_pp' THEN 'Change in the tracked share of wagers' WHEN 'tracked_theo_per_player_raw_usd' THEN 'Change in expected win per tracked player before comparison' WHEN 'tracked_theo_per_player_control_adjusted_usd' THEN 'Change in expected win per tracked player after comparison' ELSE metric END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN metric='relative_coin_in_usd_week' THEN CONCAT(IF((estimate)<0, '−', ''), '$', CASE WHEN ABS(estimate)>=999950 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS(estimate)/1000000,1),'M') WHEN ABS(estimate)>=10000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS(estimate)/1000,1),'K') ELSE FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS(estimate),0) END) WHEN metric LIKE 'tracked_theo_per_player%usd' THEN CONCAT(IF((estimate)<0, '−', ''), '$', CASE WHEN ABS(estimate)>=999950 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS(estimate)/1000000,1),'M') WHEN ABS(estimate)>=10000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS(estimate)/1000,1),'K') ELSE FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS(estimate),2) END) WHEN metric='relative_coin_in_pct' THEN CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(estimate,2),'%') ELSE CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(estimate,2),' percentage points') END

The 60-day pilot can detect a smaller change in percentage terms (5.77% versus 6.44%), even though the dollar change is larger ($7.61 versus $4.15). Expected win accumulates over more days. Wait until the pilot can detect a change of 2.50% or less.

lines: At the end of August, extend signs if both Back Forty gaps close by at least 25% against the rest of the floor. Otherwise revisit the bank-move test. Judge M-1184 against same-setting Center Pit peers because signage affects Back Forty.

## THE MODEL ROOM

The forecast shows Saturday 7 to 10 p.m. is the busiest window, but even full technician coverage there would not pay for itself in July.

**Why the primary score changed**

Gilded Ace Locals Appreciation Week was announced on May 26, after the April 30 forecast date. We removed it from the forecast, refit through April 30, and scored the frozen May and June forecasts once. Average error fell from $55,271 (4.06%) to $51,129 (3.84%). The trend model lost because it increased error in April and on the holdout.

frame.title: The weekday model cuts holdout MAE by 77%
frame.description: Frozen Jan–Apr fits. Shaded area is the 61-day May–Jun holdout.

lines: The weekday-mean baseline had the lowest April validation error at $40,715. The weekday, events and holidays model had the lowest May–June error at $51,129, compared with $68,699 for the weekday mean. We chose the primary model before adding the weekday baseline and kept that choice without using the holdout to switch models. A simple weekday average does almost as well, so events and holidays add modest accuracy.
